ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) base with localized high-intensity (white/light grey) pixel clusters. Estimated ratio of approximately 1:12 high-to-low intensity pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous dark field across the x-axis. High-contrast white clusters concentrated at the extreme distal tips (0-5% and 95-100% horizontal width). Discrete high-intensity linear and point-like anomalies scattered across the interior ventral surface, particularly in the mid-left and upper-right quadrants.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 110 degrees; depth is moderate, occupying roughly 15% of the vertical bounding box of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire span. Right lobe (viewer's right) shows greater amplitude in negative vertical excursions (notches) compared to the left lobe. Edge pixels show a jagged profile with peaks ranging from 3 to 15 pixels in depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex curvature extending from the median notch to the distal tips, with a slight increase in concavity near the terminal edges of the trailing boundary.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast, roughly circular pixel clusters with high textural relief located at the outer tips of both lobes. Smaller, isolated circular white spots (1-5 pixel diameter) are visible across the dark field of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A prominent, vertical high-intensity linear streak on the left lobe (mid-span). Multiple short, parallel diagonal linear marks located on the upper-central region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy white calcified-looking protrusions at the extreme distal tips of both lobes. Deep, irregular jagged excision on the right trailing edge approximately 60% of the way from the notch to the tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Occlusion of the lower ventral margin by high-intensity specular highlights and motion-blurred pixels corresponding to water spray/splash.
